methods.description: How the progress is drawn: `css` (the stylesheet), `native` (a scroll timeline) or `fallback` (this script, on scroll).
methods.name: mode

methods.description: How far the container (or the target) has been scrolled, from 0 to 1, measured now.
methods.name: progress

methods.description: Measures and redraws now, for example after content changed size without a scroll.
methods.name: update

parts.description: Set by the script when the browser has no scroll-driven animations (Firefox, Safari before 26) or the offset needs measuring: the script draws the progress on scroll.
parts.name: data-ok-fallback

parts.description: The `id` of the scroll container whose progress is shown. Without it (or with an unknown id): the page.
parts.name: data-ok-scroll-container

parts.description: Where the progress starts and ends: two intersections of the target and the container, separated by a comma, such as `start end, end start`.
parts.name: data-ok-scroll-offset

parts.description: The bar follows the scroll with a spring: empty for a soft spring, or spring options as JSON, such as `{"stiffness": 200, "damping": 30}`. Reduced motion turns it off.
parts.name: data-ok-scroll-smooth

parts.description: The `id` of an element: the progress follows its way through the container instead of the whole content.
parts.name: data-ok-scroll-target
